metaTitle: Room Painting in Los Angeles: What It Costs & Involves
metaDescription: Planning to repaint a room in Los Angeles? See real costs ($345–$655), what a painter actually does, and when to DIY vs hire a pro.
intro: Whether you're refreshing a bedroom in a pre-war bungalow or touching up a bedroom wall in a new-build apartment near Downtown LA, repainting a room is one of the most common home upgrades in Los Angeles. Older plaster walls, popcorn ceilings, and uneven surfaces common in the city's mid-century homes can add prep time that homeowners don't always expect.
causes: Faded or yellowed paint from years of sun exposure through large Southern California windows.
Nail holes, scuffs, and wall damage from moving furniture or hanging décor.
Cracking or peeling paint on older plaster walls typical of pre-war LA bungalows.
A desire to update a room's color scheme before selling or renting the property.
Water staining or discoloration from a past leak that needs to be sealed before repainting.
whatProDoes: Moves or covers furniture and lays down drop cloths to protect floors and fixtures.
Fills nail holes, sands rough patches, and repairs minor drywall or plaster cracks.
Applies painter's tape along trim, baseboards, and ceiling lines for clean edges.
Applies a primer coat if needed, especially on patched areas or drastic color changes.
Rolls and brushes on two coats of paint, then does a final touch-up pass before cleanup.
diyOrPro: Painting a single room with good ventilation and no significant wall damage is a reasonable DIY project for someone comfortable with a ladder and basic prep work. If you're dealing with high ceilings, extensive plaster repair, mold from a past leak, or lead-based paint (a real possibility in older pre-war LA homes built before 1978), it's safer to bring in a professional.
priceNote: This job runs $345 to $655 in Los Angeles, based on a $78/hour rate and typical completion time of 4 to 8 hours. The final cost depends on room size, how much wall repair is needed, and whether ceilings or trim are included in the job.

faqs.q: Does the $345–$655 price include paint and materials?
faqs.a: This reflects labor at $78/hour for 4-8 hours of work. Ask your painter directly whether paint, primer, and supplies are included or billed separately.

faqs.q: How long does it take to paint one room?
faqs.a: Most single rooms take 4 to 8 hours depending on size, the number of coats needed, and how much prep work (patching, sanding) is required beforehand.

faqs.q: Can a painter match my existing wall color?
faqs.a: A professional can often match an existing color using a paint chip or sample, though exact matches depend on the paint's age and any fading from sun exposure.
